'''Felfire Hill'''{{Coords|80|68|Ashenvale}} is located in [[Ashenvale]], southeast of [[Splintertree Post]], southwest of the [[Warsong Lumber Camp]], and northeast of the [[Dor'Danil Barrow Den]]. It is the site of the arrival of several [[infernal]]s during the [[Third War]], and is inhabited by all manner of foul demons. The [[Horde]] has fortified both bridges leading to the hill in order to prevent attacks on any of their nearby settlements.
